name: termflow-lite
description: A minimal, fast and customizable terminal for developers.
author: Umut Çelik (palamut62)

scripts.dev: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:remote && electron-vite dev
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.build: electron-vite build && npm run build:remote && npm run build:mcp
scripts.build:mcp: esbuild src/main/memory/serverEntry.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --log-level=warning --outfile=out/mcp/memory-server.cjs && esbuild src/main/orchestration/serverEntry.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --log-level=warning --outfile=out/mcp/agents-server.cjs && esbuild src/main/transcriptFollowEntry.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --log-level=warning --outfile=out/mcp/follow-transcript.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run dist:linux:appimage && npm run dist:linux:deb
scripts.dist:win:ide: node scripts/ide.mjs build && node scripts/ide.mjs dist:win
scripts.dist:linux:ide: node scripts/ide.mjs build && node scripts/ide.mjs dist:linux
scripts.test:e2e:ide: node scripts/ide.mjs build && playwright test --config playwright.ide.config.ts
